messages:
zoe: quick sync: proposal for a controlled seed-rotation flow so reshuffles don't shock cache/billing. core steps: preview, dry-run, staged apply, rollback.

matt: agree. API should version seed + hash_version and return a preview diff: pct_changed_by_geo + sample_users (capped).

hana: console must show estimated token-cost delta and a small sample (10k cap). add explicit 'I understand reshuffle' checkbox on commit.

infra-bot: reminder: PLTF-311 showed 12% redis miss-rate spike on prior rotation.

zoe: constraints draft: block rotation if >5% churn in last 7d; require dry_run=24h and stable rollout_exposure metrics before 1% step.

matt: staged apply steps: preview -> 1% -> 10% -> 100% with cache-warm and metric checks between steps. auto-pause on p99/redis-miss anomalies.

hana: UX: preview endpoint returns preview_id; UI shows diff_summary and can fetch sample_users for review. show geo heatmap of changes.

ops-bot: task created PLTF-712 seed-rotation-preview-api (assignee: hana).

infra-bot: implementation note: use stable hashing (xxh64) and persist hash_version in ledger. add dual-hash migration plan for upgrades.

matt: tests: deterministic mapping units, sim for distribution, stress test for cache churn and billing delta.

zoe: policy on manual seed: allow manual hex but require role gating + two-step confirm + audit entry. default auto seed format: auto:<deploy_id>:<ts>.

hana: add console annotation when seed/hash_version changes and a one-click rollback to previous seed version.

zoe: timeline: API + ledger by next week (matt), UI preview by end of sprint (hana), runbook updates (ops). i'll draft RFC and link PLTF-712. thanks. :rocket:
